title: The Inventory of Milton Flats
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Vasquez, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
